scope: Generic geometric feature intents for the requirement-to-plan interface. No shape-specific branch, no shape-specific generator or control-point patch.

feature_id.constraints: min_length 1, max_length 64, unique within the plan
feature_id.reuses_convention: existing assertion_id / constraint_id uniqueness in cad_plan_references.py

target_ref.constraints: must resolve to an existing step output_ref
target_ref.reuses_convention: existing target_ref reference validation in cad_plan_references.py

reference_ref.purpose: second target for pair-scope features such as continuity between two segments

parameters.note: Class-specific declared intent and parameters only; thresholds and expected values are never model-supplied.

acceptance_condition.source: backend-generated at validation time; must be absent from the model payload

origin.rule: Required on every feature declaration; no empty value, no 'unknown' fallback. Downstream consumers must keep this label visible; a derived feature must never be presented as user-explicit.

source_requirement_refs.rule: Every ref must resolve to a valid entry in the current immutable requirement source index (ledger requirement_id / source_id). Empty refs fail validation. The model cannot create, rename, or upgrade sources; stale previous-turn refs are rejected by the existing inheritance/stale-ref check.

evidence_text.rule: Original user wording or the extracted source clause that supports the feature; copied verbatim from the immutable source, not paraphrased by the model. For semantic_derived this is the triggering clause, not the derived feature name.

fields.rule_id: stable identifier of the extraction or matching rule that produced the declaration
fields.note: the step from source wording to the feature: for user_explicit, the lexical pattern that matched the explicit wording; for semantic_derived, the shape-semantic rule applied

fields.input_refs: source clause refs that triggered the derivation
fields.inference_steps: ordered steps from the triggering clause to the derived feature

derivation.forbidden: derivation may not cite a source clause that does not contain the triggering keyword; derived intent may not claim explicit-only authorization

authorization.reuses_convention: authorization result vocabulary from validate_junction_source_refs in cad_requirement_contract.py

feature_classes.description: An outward or inward boundary extremum along a declared direction, optionally located on a center axis.

measured_quantities.definition: boundary contains an extremum on the declared side/band

measured_quantities.normalization: x/y normalized independently to measured bounds [0,1]
normalized distance from the declared center axis band; 0 when location_axis is none

feature_classes.tolerance_source: Normalized position band reuses existing feature-detection bands; axis distance reuses the existing distance tolerance family (center_distance default 0.001, scaled to plan units).

feature_classes.description: A non-smooth turning point at an extremum or junction, distinct from a smooth G1 transition and from an intentional corner.

parameters.parent_ref: feature_id or target_ref of the associated extremum/junction

continuity_required.note: reuses existing junction intent vocabulary: smooth / intentional_cusp / intentional_corner

measured_quantities.definition: angle between the two adjacent segment chords at the point
true when tangent mismatch falls inside the smooth tolerance
optional curvature sign change at the point; null when the curve carries no curvature estimate

feature_classes.tolerance_source: Tangent angle reuses existing tangent tolerance family (tangent_tolerance_deg; parallel/perpendicular angle tolerance in cad_constraint_solver.py); chord angle helper from cad_topology_safety.py.

feature_classes.description: An inward boundary valley opening toward a declared direction, bounded between two outward neighboring lobes.

measured_quantities.normalization: x/y normalized independently to measured bounds [0,1]

measured_quantities.definition: two outward extrema exist on the neighboring sides

measured_quantities.normalization: normalized distance from the declared center axis band

feature_classes.tolerance_source: Normalized bands and distance tolerance reuse the existing families; no shape-specific threshold is introduced.

feature_classes.description: Outline or pair mirror symmetry about a declared axis.

measured_quantities.definition: max distance between mirrored corresponding point pairs
mean distance between mirrored corresponding point pairs

measured_quantities.note: selected by the backend per geometry type

feature_classes.tolerance_source: Pair distance reuses the existing center_distance default 0.001, scaled to plan units; no new symmetry-specific tolerance family.

feature_classes.description: Continuity requirement between two segments or over a whole outline; extends the existing junction intent vocabulary.

measured_quantities.definition: endpoint distance between the two segments
tangent angle mismatch at the join

feature_classes.tolerance_source: Position gap and tangent angle reuse existing junction/continuity checks and tolerance fields.

backend_generates: measurement quantity for the feature class
tolerance selected from the existing tolerance registry
anti_forgery: strict model forbids unknown fields; any model-supplied tolerance or expected value is rejected rather than applied
acceptance condition is recomputed from feature class plus contract facts at validation time
acceptance evidence is rebuilt and fingerprinted; a model-edited evidence report does not verify
H3 source authorization validation is reused; refs cannot introduce absent facts
existing candidate-saving gates and persistence conditions are not relaxed

mapping_table.trigger: Scalar parameter, interval, scale, or offset wrong; the feature set and connection relations remain intact.
mapping_table.derivation_basis: Failure touches only a scalar value; the original plan topology and feature list can be retained.

mapping_table.trigger: Continuity or junction between two segments fails.
mapping_table.derivation_basis: Local pair relation error; the overall feature list is unchanged.

mapping_table.trigger: A boundary extremum, cusp, notch, or symmetry feature is missing or misplaced in the measured geometry.
mapping_table.derivation_basis: The plan did not produce that boundary element; scalar parameter changes cannot add a topological element.

mapping_table.trigger: Component count, closure, self-intersection, nesting/containment, or connected components are wrong.
mapping_table.derivation_basis: The feature list itself or the composition relation is wrong; the overall structure must be re-derived.

failure_mapping.generic_rule: Mapping keys off feature_class and geometry_scope, not localized failure strings. Existing precedents set requires_structural_replan for missing count/topology cases.

partial_expression_gaps.existing_support: junction_constraints on composite-path steps carry intent (smooth / intentional_cusp / intentional_corner) and required_continuity; parameter-curve steps have no junction field.
gaps: Whole-outline G1/G2 continuity has no existing assertion or constraint member.
Parameter-curve steps cannot declare segment-pair continuity today.
G2_curvature measurement has no established curvature estimator in the current acceptance suite; it degrades to null rather than a passed/failed verdict.
partial_expression_gaps.degradation_behavior: When a continuity feature cannot be expressed on the current step type, the declaration is recorded as not_applicable_to_current_op, the existing junction check remains the blocking gate, and no silent pass is granted. G2 without an estimator reports evidence null and review_required instead of verified.

partial_expression_gaps.existing_support: Mirror exists only as an edit operation (composition addition), not as a solved constraint.
gaps: No constraint-solver member applies mirror symmetry to a plan.
Correspondence for free-form outlines depends on nearest-point matching; parameter correspondence is not established for arbitrary curves.
partial_expression_gaps.degradation_behavior: Measured by acceptance-layer residual only; no solver adjustment is promised. When correspondence is ambiguous, the check reports review_required rather than verified.

partial_expression_gaps.existing_support: Junction intent vocabulary already distinguishes intentional_cusp from smooth and intentional_corner; no standalone extremum/cusp measurement primitive exists on free outlines.
gaps: Cusp detection on a single closed parametric outline currently relies on position bands, not a dedicated tangent/turning-point primitive.
Curvature-sign-change measurement is optional and unavailable where no curvature estimator exists.
partial_expression_gaps.degradation_behavior: Without a tangent estimator, the cusp check falls back to the existing position-band evidence and marks the angle measurement null; it does not upgrade a band match to a verified cusp.

schema_integration_status.rationale: The five classes are acceptance measurements, not solver-input relations. They stay on the acceptance/sidecar layer for v1; promotion to a public union type only after a second executor consumer (for example solver-driven geometry generation) requires them in the plan model.
